authority.user_contract_section: 9. Geometry, lines 976-1043 in the preserved source
authority.claim_boundary: Binding RG-SW user authority for C09 only; not mentor approval, calibrated biology, or independent scientific review

activation.unknown_or_mismatched_contract: hard abort before geometry use or checkpoint field/particle deserialization

technical_tolerance.name: P11_COORDINATE_TOLERANCE_V1
technical_tolerance.formula_cm: 64 * epsilon_double * max(1 cm, absolute coordinate/domain span/segment radius/segment length)
technical_tolerance.scalar_boundary_rule: snap a scalar within the tolerance to the exact frozen boundary, then apply the lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive comparison
technical_tolerance.solid_contact_rule: distance <= radius + tolerance counts as contact
technical_tolerance.solid_penetration_rule: distance < max(0, radius - tolerance) counts as penetration
technical_tolerance.aperture_edge_rule: solid-frame contact has precedence over window eligibility
technical_tolerance.face_edge_corner_rule: apply every simultaneously active normal constraint in x then z order; retain motion tangent to all active normals
technical_tolerance.review_boundary: technical writer freeze; independent numerical review remains required before any final release run

capsule_predicates.primitive: centerline segment plus physical radius in cm
capsule_predicates.solid_geometry: lower and upper frame rectangles extruded through periodic y; nonfungal particles see the aperture as solid
capsule_predicates.window_contact: fungal capsule intersects the aperture volume and has no solid-frame contact
capsule_predicates.true_crossing: window-contacting fungal capsule reaches both x < -0.05 and x >= 0.05
capsule_predicates.periodic_canonicalization: map y to [0,0.1); the upper endpoint maps to the lower endpoint

particle_mechanics.solid_collision: project the proposed capsule to the nearest valid side, remove outward normal displacement/velocity, preserve tangential translation
particle_mechanics.fungal_aperture: passage allowed only without solid-frame contact
particle_mechanics.swept_motion_rule: test old and proposed capsules plus both endpoint trajectories; on any solid penetration, project to the nearest valid fungus-side first-contact support plane
particle_mechanics.rotation_collision_rule: retain the proposed orientation only after the translated capsule is nonpenetrating; otherwise reject the rotation and apply the translational constraint
particle_mechanics.event_boundary: one final owned-particle traversal per EvolveParticles update after redistribution
particle_mechanics.event_identity: globally stable AMReX particle id plus timestep update id plus geometry contract id

operational_motion_record.attempted_penetration: MPI-global count of particle-substep proposals that violate an internal or outer hard boundary
operational_motion_record.projected_motion: MPI-global count of those proposals whose pose is projected to an allowed support surface
operational_motion_record.tangential_motion: MPI-global count of projected proposals retaining a nonzero displacement tangent to every active normal
operational_motion_record.rejected_growth: MPI-global count reserved for an authorized growth/debit operator; exactly zero in C09 because C09 introduces no growth or B/E debit behavior
operational_motion_record.counter_scope: reset at each EvolveParticles update and emitted once with the final geometry event record
operational_motion_record.duplicate_update_rule: duplicate or out-of-order update identifiers hard abort

mesh_boundary.divider_surface: every x-normal face at x=0 on every active AMR level, including aperture

checkpoint.comparison: exact identifiers, exact periodicity, exact round-tripped binary Real domain values
checkpoint.legacy_or_mismatch: reject before field or particle deserialization
checkpoint.event_dedup_persistence: no cross-update set is stored; timestep identity is already checkpointed and each update performs one final owned traversal

prohibited: Eulerian P leakage through the aperture
